name: RGX-121-3102
summary: RGX-121 (clemidsogene lanparvovec) is REGENXBIO's one-time AAV9 gene therapy for MPS II (Hunter syndrome), given intracisternally or intraventricularly to deliver the IDS gene to the CNS. It is not approved. The FDA issued a complete response letter on 2026-02-07, announced 2026-02-09 (8-K 0001193125-26-043342). On 2026-08-24 the FDA put the RGX-121 IND on clinical hold after asymptomatic spine MRI findings in five CAMPSIITE participants. REGENXBIO 'does not expect to resubmit the RGX-121 BLA in the near term' (8-K 0001193125-26-363786). Nippon Shinyaku holds US and Asian commercial rights. REGENXBIO's filings disclose only 'double-digit royalties ... subject to specified offsets and reductions', plus milestones and supply at cost plus a margin. REFUSED on two grounds: the partner share has no filed rate, and no regulatory path or launch year can be set. No price or uptake was researched.

therapy_mode.source: REGENXBIO 8-K 2026-08-24 (0001193125-26-363786, EX-99.1): 'RGX-121 is a one-time investigational gene therapy for the treatment of boys with MPS II'; 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-336725) MD&A: 'an investigational one-time AAV therapeutic'
therapy_mode.note: Recorded for completeness. The asset is refused, so the other pricing fields were not researched

pos.source: 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-336725) MD&A: 'In February 2026, we announced that the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter (CRL) for the RGX-121 BLA.' CRL dated 2026-02-07 and announced 2026-02-09: 8-K 0001193125-26-043342, filed 2026-02-10, document rgnx-20260207.htm (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1590877/000119312526043342/rgnx-ex99_1.htm; date read from the search summary, the book holds the filing row but not its text). 8-K 0001193125-26-363786 (2026-08-24): clinical hold, and no BLA resubmission expected in the near term
pos.note: Not approved, so pos is not 1.0. The engine computes pos itself. Timeline from the filings: BLA filed March 2025 for accelerated approval, with priority review. The PDUFA date moved from 2025-11-09 to 2026-02-08 after 12-month data were filed. On 2026-01 a partial clinical hold followed an AAV-integration tumour in an RGX-111 patient, and it was lifted on 2026-04-30. CRL on 2026-02-07: the FDA doubted the eligibility criteria (neuronopathic vs attenuated), the natural-history external control, and CSF HS D2S6 as a surrogate. A formal dispute followed. In June 2026 REGENXBIO announced alignment with the FDA that no new study was needed, and a Type A meeting took place in July 2026. The plan then was to resubmit in Q3 2026 (10-Q 0001193125-26-336725). On 2026-08-24 came the new clinical hold, after 'a small nodule or a small cystic mass' in the spine MRIs of five participants dosed three to six years earlier, and the resubmission was deferred. The CEO said the company will 'remain focused on our Duchenne and retinal disease candidates'

economics_share.source: REGENXBIO FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-094013), Note 10 and MD&A; repeated in the 10-Q Q2 2026 (0001193125-26-336725). The agreement took effect in March 2025. 'Nippon Shinyaku is responsible, at its sole cost, for the commercialization of RGX-121 and RGX-111 in the licensed territories' (the US and certain countries in Asia). $110.0mm upfront. Up to $700.0mm in milestones, 'of which $40.0 million are based on development milestones and $660.0 million are sales-based milestones'. 'Nippon Shinyaku is also required to pay to the Company double-digit royalties on net sales of RGX-121 and RGX-111 in the licensed territories, subject to specified offsets and reductions.' REGENXBIO makes commercial supply, and its selling price 'was determined based on the expected cost plus a reasonable margin' (10-K revenue-recognition note). No margin figure is given
economics_share.note: Null, which is the refusal ground. REGENXBIO does not sell RGX-121 in the US or Asia; it receives a royalty. The house netting is royalty / margin, and it needs a rate. The filings give only 'double-digit', which spans 10% to 99% with no tier or ceiling, and it is further 'subject to specified offsets and reductions'. The supply margin is also unstated. A web search found no disclosed rate. The same wording ('tiered double-digit royalties') is why the GSK linerixibat seed was refused. Taking 10% would be a floor chosen by us, not a filed figure. Not in this field: $40mm in development milestones and $660mm in sales milestones. Those are deal cash, and they are pledged: the May 2025 HCR loan is repaid from 'future royalties, sales-based milestone payments and certain development milestone payments earned under the Nippon Shinyaku Collaboration Agreement' (10-Q 0001193125-26-336725). Also excluded is any Rare Pediatric Disease priority review voucher. REGENXBIO keeps 'all rights to, and any proceeds related to the sale of' it (10-K 0001193125-26-094013). It is not product revenue, and none can issue without approval. REGENXBIO keeps the rights outside the licensed territories, such as Europe (EMA ATMP classification only), but it has no filing or plan there

forecast_start_year.source: 8-K 2026-08-24 (0001193125-26-363786): IND on clinical hold; 'REGENXBIO does not expect to resubmit the RGX-121 Biologics License Application (BLA) in the near term'. The company and NS Pharma 'will incorporate FDA feedback, including the full clinical hold letter once received, into next steps'. The latest RGNX filing in the book (8-K 2026-09-23, 0001193125-26-399377, the Sarepta patent settlement) gives no RGX-121 update
forecast_start_year.note: Null. No resubmission date is stated, so no launch year can be sourced. NCT07236606 (RGX-121-3102, the context's Phase 3) is Active not recruiting, with 2 enrolled and an estimated primary completion of 2028-04-30 (book trials table). It was not the basis of the BLA, which rested on CAMPSIITE (NCT03566043, Phase 1/2/3, 48 enrolled)

cogs_per_patient.source: none filed. The 10-K (0001193125-26-094013) gives only the selling price basis for commercial supply to Nippon Shinyaku ('expected cost plus a reasonable margin')
cogs_per_patient.note: Left null: no filed per-patient cost

rebuild_notes: For a rebuild if the hold lifts and a rate is disclosed. (1) The book carries no MPS II pool: lookup.py pool returns nothing for 'Mucopolysacchar', 'Hunter' or 'MPS', and epidemiology.csv has no line, so a US prevalence and birth incidence must be sourced. REGENXBIO's only figures are worldwide: 'Approximately 2,000 patients worldwide are diagnosed with MPS II, with more than 500 babies born annually around the world' (8-K 0001193125-26-363786). They are not a US pool. (2) The label population would be neuronopathic MPS II in boys. The CRL questioned exactly this eligibility definition, so eligible_pct depends on the eventual label. (3) Elaprase (idursulfase), the incumbent ERT, has no row in the book's drug_demand (lookup.py demand Elaprase and demand idursulf return nothing). The MPS ERTs that do have rows are Aldurazyme, Naglazyme and Vimizim, in both Part B and Part D. The Part B rule (gross_to_net 0.056604) would apply to a Part B ERT anchor. A one-time AAV therapy would more likely anchor on a gene-therapy list price. (4) The asset is misnamed in the book: the generic_name 'RGX-121-3102' is a trial number. The asset is clemidsogene lanparvovec (RGX-121). A REGENXBIO release title in search results uses the proposed brand NAVSUNLI (ir.regenxbio.com, 'Alignment with FDA on Path Forward for NAVSUNLI BLA Resubmission'; the title was seen in search results only)
refuse: Two grounds. (1) The partner's share of economics cannot be sourced from a filing. Nippon Shinyaku commercialises RGX-121 in the US and Asia at its own cost. REGENXBIO receives only 'double-digit royalties on net sales ... subject to specified offsets and reductions' (10-K 0001193125-26-094013; 10-Q 0001193125-26-336725), with no rate, tier or ceiling, plus milestones and cost-plus supply at an unstated margin. The GSK linerixibat seed was refused on the same wording. (2) There is no current regulatory path. The FDA issued a CRL on 2026-02-07 (8-K 0001193125-26-043342), and on 2026-08-24 placed the IND on clinical hold after spine MRI findings in five participants. REGENXBIO 'does not expect to resubmit the RGX-121 BLA in the near term' (8-K 0001193125-26-363786), so no launch year can be set. The asset is not discontinued. Revisit it if the hold lifts and a royalty rate is filed. Milestones ($40mm development, $660mm sales, pledged to HCR) and any priority review voucher belong in deal and other-income rows, not product revenue.
